about_the_game:
Upgrade to the Digital Deluxe Edition to claim amazing rewards, including an exclusive mount, special equipment and costumes!

- Exclusive Mount: Napminigon

- Exclusive Napdragon Battle Weapons: Napdragon Sword, Napdragon Claymore, Napdragon Bow, Napdragon Staff

- Character Dress-Up Kit: White Maiden's Robe, White Maiden's Sandals, Archaeologist's Hat, Archaeologist's Coat, Archaeologist's Boots,Trip's Headgear

*Visit the official website for more details about the bonuses included with each edition.
